paragraphs: 6 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Tuesday for 6 clubs across 3 levels, with Ryan Tayman producing the night's most notable performance.

Ryan Tayman's home run — his 3th of the season came in the seventh inning on a 1-0 91 mph four-seam fastball from Janero Miller. The swing moved the score from 3-6 to 6-6. Statcast measured the ball at 106.7 mph off the bat, a 22-degree launch angle, 393 feet.
Ryan Tayman went 1-for-3, 1 home run, 3 RBI, 2 runs scored, 1 walk.
He batted second and started behind the plate.
St. Lucie Mets beat Jupiter Hammerheads, 7-6.

Bryan Woo started on the mound for Seattle Mariners. He worked 6.0 innings, allowing 5 hits and 1 earned run, with 1 walk and 7 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the third on a 2-2 97 mph sinker, when he put away Ceddanne Rafaela. Seattle Mariners beat Boston Red Sox, 9-6.

Alejandro Garza went 2-for-4, 1 double, 2 RBI for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. Alejandro Garza drove in 1 run with a double in the second to left field on a 2-2 pitch from Ethan Walker. Alejandro Garza drove in 1 run with a sacrifice fly in the fourth to right field on a 3-1 pitch from Carson Revay. He batted first and started at second base. Hill City Howlers fell to Salem RidgeYaks, 7-8.

Brooks Lee went 0-for-3, 1 RBI for Minnesota Twins. Brooks Lee drove in his lone run with a sacrifice fly in the sixth to deep center field on a 3-1 96 mph four-seam fastball from Kyle Finnegan. He batted second and started at third base. Minnesota Twins beat Detroit Tigers, 15-2.
Ryan Stafford went 0-for-3 for Frederick Keys at High-A. He batted eighth and started behind the plate. Frederick Keys beat Brooklyn Cyclones, 6-4.
Zach Daudet went 0-for-3 for Asheville Tourists at High-A. He batted seventh and started at shortstop. Asheville Tourists fell to Greensboro Grasshoppers, 0-15.
title: Ryan Tayman delivers in a key spot
